fusions.name: Lime Crust
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 30 necrotic damage, ignoring armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound and with [Rigor Mortis], which lowers its Speed and Recovery, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reef Swell
fusions.desc: A swell of water deals 12 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles, with a 40% chance per hit to leave them [Diseased] for 6 seconds. The disease spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Polyp Colony
fusions.desc: Grows a colony of spore-bearing polyps for 15 seconds that strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: When you regain health, you gain a ward worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
